I am a econometrician with depth in mechanism design, a PhD candidate at UC San Diego.

In econometrics I am interested in treatment effect heterogeneity, e.g. estimation, and consequences for interpretation of popular estimands. In mechanism design I am interested in information aquisition.

More broadly, I am an engineer in heart, and therefore I like to engineer solutions to problems economic applications face, let it be an estimator/an interpretation of an estimator, or a mechanism to allocate a good.

Before UC San Diego, my previous jobs and former collegues formed my research taste at [Yandex.Go](https://go.yandex/), Department of Economics at Moscow State University and [Research Fellowship program at Stanford](https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/programs/research-fellows).
